directory_policies.notes.8: Preparation: The linked AY26-27 handbook expects analytic ability and mathematical, programming and reasoning aptitude, but does not require a CS major or list universal entry-course cutoffs. The declared CS/ECE Standard-track path has no additional universal course check. Other backgrounds remain for individual preparation and possible extended-track review.

fact_summary: The current linked handbook establishes bachelor-level entry without a compulsory CS major. Aptitude is evaluated individually; named courses in the graduate curriculum are not universal admission prerequisites. Other backgrounds can require an additional semester.
